what_it_is: Aadyah Aerospace is a Bengaluru space-systems company (founded 2016) building satellite subsystems - motion control, guidance and navigation, avionics and power - plus launch-vehicle systems. It positions itself as a subsystem OEM for Indian and international satellite and launcher programmes.
india_angle: Aadyah sits in Bengaluru's supplier layer beneath India's launch boom: its subsystem catalogue serves both private constellation builders and launch-vehicle programmes. Series-A stage and its supplier listings are public via trackers.
intelligence_assessment: Subsystem suppliers like Aadyah are strategically important but hard to verify at programme level; most evidence is catalogue-based. Watch supplier credits on Indian launches and satellite missions.

faq.a: Satellite subsystems (motion control, GNC, avionics, power) and launch-vehicle systems from Bengaluru.
